title: Find a location and fix its label
description: Drill Explore down to a location, open the system it holds, and rename the location from Configure. The new label follows everywhere the location is read.

steps.caption: Explore is the outline of every location in the fleet, with what each one holds.
Open a building. Each location inside reads its type, and the standard its system is built to.
Bay 3 holds one system, so opening the location opens that system.
The system's panel names the place it sits in, above its own facts.
Expand the panel to the system's full view.
A location holding one system has no page of its own. The system's view is titled by it, with the location as a card below.
Configure holds the location's form first, then the system's.
Edit the location, apart from its system. Its label was rendered by a label rule from its name.
Click the label to take it over from the rule.
The label is yours now; the rule no longer rewrites it.
Say what the site calls it, so operators find it by that word.
Saved. Back on the system's overview, its title already reads the new label.
Back to Explore, opened down to the location you were on.
The outline reads the new label too. One location, one label, wherever it is read.
